Name: Rias Gremory for Haley - Portraits and Sprites
Author: Jolamods
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Rias Gremory for Haley[/b][/size]
[size=4]莉雅丝·吉蒙里替换海莉[/size]
Portraits + Sprites | 头像 + 人物精灵[/center]

[b]ENGLISH[/b]
Bring Rias Gremory's crimson hair and blue eyes to Pelican Town. This Content Patcher pack replaces Haley's dialogue portraits and overworld sprites while keeping her existing name, dialogue, schedules and events.

[b]What's included[/b]
[list]
[*]14 portrait slots with happy, sad, annoyed, blushing, angry, surprised and other expressions, including muddy event variants.[/*]
[*]Complete normal, winter and beach sprite sheets with four-direction walking and the original game's special pose slots.[/*]
[*]Camera, kissing, wedding and Flower Dance frames, plus sleep and beach-rest poses where present in the original sheets.[/*]
[*]Winter clothing with a teal scarf and earmuffs; a teal summer outfit for the beach.[/*]
[*]Separate config switches for portraits, sprites and seasonal replacements.[/*]
[/list]Normal sprites: 64 × 416 pixels. Winter: 64 × 384. Beach: 64 × 192. Each sprite cell is 16 × 32. Portraits: 128 × 448 with 64 × 64 cells. Normal, winter and beach dialogue use the same portrait sheet; seasonal sprite outfits are separate.

[b]Requirements and installation[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6 on PC.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.1.10 or newer[/url].
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer[/url].
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Close the game and extract the enclosed [CP] Rias Portraits for Haley folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Check that Mods/[CP] Rias Portraits for Haley/manifest.json exists without an extra wrapper folder.
4. Disable other mods replacing Haley's portraits or sprites.
5. Launch through SMAPI.
When updating, replace the old Rias folder. Keep config.json if customized. Do not install duplicate versions.

[b]Configuration[/b]
Content Patcher creates or updates config.json on launch. All switches default to true:
[list]
[*]Enabled — entire pack.[/*]
[*]ReplacePortraits — dialogue portraits.[/*]
[*]ReplaceSprites — overworld sprites.[/*]
[*]ReplaceSeasonalPortraits — winter and beach portraits.[/*]
[*]ReplaceSeasonalSprites — winter and beach sprites.[/*]
[/list]For sprites only, set ReplacePortraits to false. For portraits only, set ReplaceSprites to false. To uninstall, close the game and remove the folder from Mods.

[b]Compatibility and testing[/b]
This is a visual replacement; Haley's name and story stay unchanged. Photos, decorations and art baked into other textures are outside its scope. Mods replacing the same assets or reordering animation frames may conflict. Portraiture and an HD sprite framework are not required.
The gallery contains user-provided in-game screenshots showing outdoor sprites and selected dialogue and event portraits, including the darkroom and muddy portrait. Sheet dimensions, occupied and empty slots, transparency, JSON paths and archive structure have been checked. Comprehensive testing of every frame, event, season and mod combination has not been completed.

[b]Want more anime characters?[/b]
Would you like more anime characters in Stardew Valley, or a replacement for a different villager? Leave a comment with the anime character you want and the Stardew Valley character they should replace. Requests are welcome, but I cannot promise every suggestion will be made.

[b]Credits and AI disclosure[/b]
Pack author: Joel (Jolamods). Stardew Valley and original animation layout: ConcernedApe. Rias Gremory / High School DxD belongs to its respective rights holders. SMAPI and Content Patcher belong to their respective developers.
Portrait variants, sprites and the promotional cover were generated with AI, then arranged and resized into native sheets. Page text and translations were AI-assisted. The original character reference was supplied by the author; its artist has not been identified in the supplied materials. Gallery screenshots were supplied by the author. This is an unofficial fan mod. The cover is promotional illustration; screenshots show the actual in-game appearance.

[line]
[b]简体中文[/b]
让拥有红色长发与蓝色眼睛的莉雅丝·吉蒙里来到鹈鹕镇！本Content Patcher内容包替换海莉的对话头像与地图人物精灵，同时保留她原有的姓名、对话、日程与事件。

[b]包含内容[/b]
[list]
[*]14栏位头像图集，包含开心、伤心、不悦、脸红、生气、惊讶等表情，以及事件中的沾泥表情。[/*]
[*]完整的日常、冬季与海滩人物精灵图集，包含四方向行走与原版特殊姿势栏位。[/*]
[*]相机动作、接吻姿势、婚礼与花舞节帧，以及原图集中存在的睡眠和海滩休息姿势。[/*]
[*]带青绿色围巾与耳罩的冬季服装，以及青绿色海滩夏装。[/*]
[*]头像、人物精灵和季节替换可分别开关。[/*]
[/list]日常精灵64 × 416像素，冬季64 × 384，海滩64 × 192；每格16 × 32。头像128 × 448像素，每格64 × 64。日常、冬季和海滩对话使用同一套头像；季节人物精灵有独立服装。

[b]前置要求与安装[/b]
PC版星露谷物语1.6。
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.1.10或更新版本[/url]。
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher 2.9.0或更新版本[/url]。
1. 安装SMAPI和Content Patcher。
2. 关闭游戏，将压缩包内的[CP] Rias Portraits for Haley文件夹解压到Stardew Valley/Mods。
3. 确认存在Mods/[CP] Rias Portraits for Haley/manifest.json，避免多套一层文件夹。
4. 禁用其他替换海莉头像或人物精灵的Mod。
5. 通过SMAPI启动游戏。
更新时用新版文件夹替换旧版；若修改过配置，可保留config.json。不要同时安装多个版本。

[b]配置选项[/b]
启动时Content Patcher创建或更新config.json，以下选项默认均为true：
[list]
[*]Enabled — 启用整个内容包。[/*]
[*]ReplacePortraits — 对话头像。[/*]
[*]ReplaceSprites — 地图人物精灵。[/*]
[*]ReplaceSeasonalPortraits — 冬季与海滩头像。[/*]
[*]ReplaceSeasonalSprites — 冬季与海滩人物精灵。[/*]
[/list]仅使用人物精灵时将ReplacePortraits设为false；仅使用头像时将ReplaceSprites设为false。卸载时关闭游戏并从Mods移除文件夹。

[b]兼容性与测试说明[/b]
本Mod仅替换外观，不修改海莉的姓名或故事。其他纹理中的照片、装饰与人物图像不在替换范围内。修改相同素材或重排动画帧的Mod可能冲突。无需Portraiture或高清人物精灵框架。
图库包含作者提供的游戏内截图，展示户外精灵及部分对话、事件头像，包括暗房和沾泥头像。已检查图集尺寸、非空与空白栏位、透明度、JSON路径和压缩包结构。尚未完成所有帧、事件、季节及Mod组合的全面游戏内测试。

[b]想看到更多动漫角色吗？[/b]
你希望我制作更多动漫角色，或为其他村民制作替换吗？欢迎在评论中写下你想要的动漫角色，以及希望替换的星露谷人物。欢迎提出建议，但无法保证每个请求都会制作。

[b]致谢与AI使用说明[/b]
作者：Joel（Jolamods）。星露谷物语与原版动画布局：ConcernedApe。莉雅丝·吉蒙里及《恶魔高校DxD》归各自权利人所有。SMAPI与Content Patcher归各自开发者所有。
头像表情、人物精灵和宣传封面由AI生成，随后整理并缩放为游戏原生图集。页面文字与翻译使用AI辅助。原始人物参考图由作者提供，所提供资料中尚未确认其画师。图库截图由作者提供。本Mod为非官方同人作品。封面为宣传插画，请以游戏截图判断实际游戏内效果。
